snippet.title: super mushroom kingdom 64 - i demade all of kingdoms hearts levels and put them in sm64
snippet.description:
game is beatable all levels from kingdom hearts 1 completely remade in n64 limits and ported into mario 64. there are 59 stars to collect only need 45 to beat it. 
as i said in the video. i had alot of set backs during this so im posting this as is just so my work can be enjoyed by someone lol.
you van find the bps here 
as well as the zip with all the models if youd like to take the torch via decomp and make this mod as great as it could of been lol.

mod download
https://www.romhacking.net/hacks/7535/

for the models though you have to dig
do plan on having a better place to go for them soon.
https://discord.com/channels/703951576162762813/705535300700733490
